items.title: How Cohere Health digitizes clinical policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: In this post, you learn how Cohere Health built a multi-tenant agentic architecture on AgentCore using AgentCore Runtime’s secure MicroVM isolation, unified tool access through AgentCore Gateway, AgentCore Memory, and the Agent Skills open standard to rapidly scale policy digitization capabilities, while preserving transparency, version control, and human oversight.

items.title: How TReNDS automates root-cause analysis with Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: TReNDS, a research center at Georgia State University, built an agentic AI pipeline on Amazon Bedrock and the open-source Strands Agents SDK that automatically investigates production errors in real time, reducing root-cause analysis from 15 to 30 minutes of manual work to under 60 seconds.

items.title: Determining playoff clinching scenarios in the NHL using constraint programming
items.summary: The AWS Generative AI Innovation Center built an automated system that uses constraint programming and custom tree search to determine, with mathematical certainty, when and how an NHL team clinches a playoff spot. The approach was validated against four full NHL seasons of officially published results.

items.title: Securing AI agents with temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Temporal policies in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore let you define stateful rules that evaluate authorization based on an agent’s session history. Learn how to enforce workflow sequencing, prevent data fabrication, cap financial exposure, and require human approval for high-value actions.

items.title: Configure rate limits for AI traffic on AgentCore gateway
items.summary: Learn how to configure rate limits on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore gateway to enforce per-user and per-target traffic controls. Define request, token, and connection limits scoped by JWT claims or IAM identity to protect downstream models, tools, and agents from traffic spikes.

items.title: Control agent behaviors and cost beyond a single action: new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Learn about new capabilities in Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: temporal policies powered by Dogwood, a new open source policy language for AI agents, and rate limiting on the gateway. These features give you deterministic control over sequences of agent actions and cost ceilings that hold regardless of agent behavior.

items.title: Build visibility for Codex on Amazon Bedrock with OpenTelemetry and Amazon CloudWatch
items.summary: As engineering teams adopt coding agents like Codex, leaders need visibility into adoption, consumption, and reliability. This post shows how to route Codex OpenTelemetry metrics through a local collector to Amazon CloudWatch for an AWS native view of usage by user, team, and cost center.

items.title: Agent Skills for Automated Reasoning policies in Amazon Bedrock
items.summary: Learn how to run the full Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning policy lifecycle from your coding agent. A suite of open source Agent Skills builds, reviews, tests, debugs, deploys, and validates a custom policy end to end, turning a specialized console task into a repeatable engineering workflow.

items.title: Building an agentic app deployer with Amazon Bedrock and AWS Lambda
items.summary: PDI Technologies built PDI Brew, an agentic platform on AWS where non-technical employees describe a tool in plain English and receive a fully provisioned, multi-tenant web application in seconds. See how a pluggable planner and an AWS Lambda provisioning agent turn plain-English intent into governed, multi-tenant apps backed by Amazon Bedrock.

items.title: LLM optimization integration for Amazon SageMaker Python SDK
items.summary: The Amazon SageMaker Python SDK v3 now exposes generative AI inference recommendations in Amazon SageMaker AI directly in your notebook. Benchmark an endpoint, generate data-driven deployment recommendations, and deploy the recommended configuration without leaving your notebook workflow.
